definitions.gloss: to flare up, to burst into flames, to blaze up
definitions.explanation: For fire or flames to suddenly rise up intensely. Describes the dramatic moment when something catches fire or when flames grow in intensity.

definitions.gloss: to be inflamed, to burn with passion
definitions.explanation: For emotions such as anger, passion, or fighting spirit to surge intensely. A figurative extension of the fire imagery.

examples.english: The fire flared up all at once in the wind.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ({燃|も}え{上|あ}がる → {燃|も}え{上|あ}がります). A compound verb formed from ⟦{燃|も}える→燃える：02312_moeru⟧ (to burn) + ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to rise). Intransitive — there is no direct transitive counterpart.

The ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ component adds the nuance of upward movement and sudden intensification, distinguishing this from the more neutral ⟦{燃|も}える→燃える：02312_moeru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{炎|ほのお}→炎：03724_honoo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{燃|も}え{上|あ}がる: flames flare up
- ⟦{闘志|とうし}→闘志：19440_toushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{燃|も}え{上|あ}がる: fighting spirit flares up
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{燃|も}え{上|あ}がる: anger flares up
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{燃|も}え{上|あ}がる: to blaze up all at once
